target.label: Working tree - Persist customerEmail
target.description: Mock target representing the SaveOrderDB customerEmail persistence change

analysis.title: Persist customer email during order save

summary.headline: SaveOrder now passes customerEmail into SaveOrderDB so the orders table can persist it.
items: SaveOrderDBInput gained a new string field: customerEmail.
SaveOrder flow added one MAPCOPY from OrderDocument/order/customerEmail to SaveOrderDBInput/customerEmail.
SaveOrderDB SQL now inserts customer_email and expects one additional bind parameter.
No new service invocation was introduced; the execution path is unchanged.

affectedAssets.name: OrderProcessing.orderProcessing.services:SaveOrder
affectedAssets.description: Adds a new input mapping into SaveOrderDBInput while preserving the existing orderId, customerId, finalAmount, discountAmount, and orderStatus mappings.

affectedAssets.name: OrderProcessing.orderProcessing.adapters:SaveOrderDB
affectedAssets.description: SaveOrderDBInput now includes customerEmail as an additional string field.

affectedAssets.name: SaveOrderDB/query.sql
affectedAssets.description: The insert statement now writes customer_email and has six placeholders instead of five.

affectedAssets.name: OrderProcessing.orderProcessing.docs:OrderDocument
affectedAssets.description: The existing customerEmail field is now consumed by the persistence path; the document definition itself is unchanged.

drivers: Adapter input contract changed for SaveOrderDB.
Database insert statement now requires a customer_email column and one more bind value.
Persistence assertions and downstream reporting may need updates.
No orchestration or scheduler behavior changed, limiting blast radius.

regressionTests.name: Order save includes customer email
regressionTests.scenario: Run an order with OrderDocument/order/customerEmail populated and verify SaveOrderDB receives customerEmail.

regressionTests.name: Existing save mappings remain intact
regressionTests.scenario: Verify orderId, customerId, finalAmount, discountAmount, and orderStatus are still mapped to SaveOrderDBInput.

regressionTests.name: Database insert parameter alignment
regressionTests.scenario: Confirm the orders insert binds six values in the same order as the SQL column list.

regressionTests.name: Missing customer email behavior
regressionTests.scenario: Run an order without customerEmail and verify expected null or validation behavior for the target database column.

regressionTests.name: Scheduler orchestration smoke test
regressionTests.scenario: Invoke scheduler and confirm the existing OrderProcessing path still reaches SaveOrder and SendConfirmation.
